explanation: Public requirement explicitly supplies a Maintain account. Actual roleFor must resolve at least one such startup account/repository pair, without inventing or mutating fixtures.
subject: roleFor
check: const roles=ARC.state.repositories.flatMap(r=>ARC.state.users.map(u=>roleFor(r,u)));assert.ok(roles.includes('Maintain'),'The actual startup accounts have no Maintain permission on any repository');

explanation: Public requirement supplies separate Open PRs for eligible and missing-approval cases. Observe the unchanged startup PRs with the actual merge predicate.
subject: mergeBlocked
check: const open=ARC.state.pulls.filter(p=>p.state==='Open');const conditions=open.map(p=>mergeBlocked(p,ARC.state.repositories.find(r=>r.id===p.repoId)));assert.ok(open.length>=2,'The required separate Open success/refusal fixtures are not present');assert.ok(conditions.some(x=>!x),'There is no initially eligible Open PR');assert.ok(conditions.includes('Review required by branch protection'),'There is no Open PR blocked by the missing required approval');
